entities.name: Q9P7P9
observations: Exact sequence match to the analyzed 184-aa protein; reviewed Schizosaccharomyces pombe protein annotated as uncharacterized isomerase C186.06.
Curated localization places the protein in the cytoplasm and nucleus.
GO annotations include catalytic activity (GO:0003824), cytosol (GO:0005829), and nucleus (GO:0005634).
The sequence contains a PhzC-PhzF domain (PF02567.22) spanning residues 9–173; domain evidence supports an isomerase-like catalytic fold but does not establish exact substrate specificity.
